method: Continuous starting-XI droughts are four or more consecutive active-fixture starts below five realised points. Causal warnings use only the current deadline's forecast, minutes, market and affordable-replacement values. Future three-week replacement points are explicitly hindsight diagnostics.

replay.scope: The final stored weights, chip policy and decision strategy are replayed unchanged across every evaluation season. This is a forensic diagnostic, not the published season-by-season walk-forward score.

availability.warning: The carried weekly XI applies a 60% severe-risk safety floor. Rows below the stricter live 84% standard can be valid rotation risks; a tested 78% historical hard floor reduced points and was rejected.

repairedInconsistencies.finding: Exact rebuilds retain the causal XI floor and one exceptional-upside allowance. Carried squads use a 60% severe-risk safety floor; the proposed 78% weekly floor was rejected after losing 16.3 points in ablation.

Candidate screening remains availability-aware, while the final transfer hurdle uses causal planning points. Forcing the same penalised objective at both stages lost 26.4 points in the final high-precision ablation and was rejected.
Nullable live chances now fall back by official status: available 100, doubtful 75, and injured/suspended/unavailable/not-in-squad 0.
The deadline API now propagates an availability change through minutes, projected points, six-week value, captain utility, distributions, components and optimiser features.

Trusted deadline xP-zero reduces historical start/play probabilities only when corroborated by extreme selling, a prior zero/no-show or a curtailed appearance; per-GW feed-quality guards disable corrupted all-zero snapshots.

live.source: Official FPL bootstrap-static player status, chance_of_playing_next_round, news and news_added
live.use: Forecast input immediately before every deadline

historicalCausal.source: Archived official FPL players_raw snapshots in the vaastav FPL repository commit history
historicalCausal.use: Select only a commit timestamped before the simulated deadline and reject news_added after the deadline

retrospectiveReason.source: withqwerty availability-data weekly matchday classifications derived from Transfermarkt
retrospectiveReason.use: Explain an absence after the event; never feed it into a causal backtest
